formulae.acclim_anom_c: max 3-day mean Tmean minus preceding 30-day mean Tmean; Tmean=(Tmax+Tmin)/2
formulae.peak_wbt_c: max hourly Stull wet-bulb approximation from temperature and relative humidity
formulae.run_tmax_ge40_d: longest consecutive run where daily Tmax >= 40.0 C

primary_gt.computed_consequence: The ledger supports cumulative daytime heat with limited night recovery, not a humid-ceiling or one-day-spike diagnosis.

criteria.description: Returns target_family = numeric_diagnosis and the final label persistent_early_season_dry_heat_recovery_stress or an exact semantic equivalent.
criteria.name: target_family_and_answer
criteria.partial_credit: Give partial credit for a persistent dry-heat label that omits either early-season timing or night-recovery stress.

criteria.description: Reports peak_tmax_c = 45.3, run_tmax_ge40_d = 9, warm_nights_ge25 = 25, peak_wbt_c = 27.3, and acclim_anom_c = 4.5 within stated tolerances.
criteria.name: metric_ledger_values
criteria.partial_credit: Score proportionally for correct metric values, units, and rounding.

criteria.description: Uses longest-run logic, warm-night counting, hourly Stull wet-bulb estimation, and the 3-day mean versus prior-30-day anomaly formula correctly.
criteria.name: formula_and_window_reconstruction
criteria.partial_credit: Give partial credit for correct values with one formula or window error.

criteria.description: Sets persistent_heat, warm_night_recovery_loss, and early_season_jump to true, sets wet_bulb_ceiling and isolated_spike to false, and uses those gates to reach the final label.
criteria.name: gate_ledger_and_decision_rule
criteria.partial_credit: Give partial credit for one incorrect gate with the correct overall diagnosis.

criteria.description: Rejects wet-bulb-ceiling and isolated-spike alternatives using the inequalities 27.3 < 28.0 and 9 > 2.
criteria.name: computed_alternative_rejection
criteria.partial_credit: Give partial credit for rejecting only one alternative with a numeric basis.

criteria.description: Gives one consequence tied to cumulative daytime heat and limited night recovery, without turning the answer into an action plan.
criteria.name: bounded_computed_consequence
criteria.partial_credit: Give partial credit for a plausible consequence that is weakly tied to the ledger.

criteria.description: Keeps the JSON compact and avoids uncomputed mortality, crop-loss, power-grid, or region-wide damage totals.
criteria.name: compact_output_and_overclaim_control
criteria.partial_credit: No credit if the answer becomes a broad disaster explanation or extra loss accounting.
